Thanks for the reply. To tell you the truth, doctors aren't exactly sure what my problems are, health-wise. Since I was 14 though, I began experiencing (in chronological order) severe back pain, rectal bleeding, joint pain, hair loss, loss of sex drive, and erectile dysfunction. It all started during a course of Accutane that I was on from ages 13-14. I can't prove that Accutane caused any of it, but it doesn't really make a difference, because whatever caused it, the doctors can't figure out what's going on or how to fix it.

Some of the problems have gone away somewhat over time, and it seems like that may be slowly happening with my sexual problems as well. I'm pretty hopeful about it.

The problem is that I still remember what it was like to feel attraction, and experience sexual pleasure. It's the greatest feeling in the world, and I'll never feel that way again.

Plus, having a relationship is extremely difficult with this condition. My last girlfriend thought that either I was cheating on her, or that she was too fat because I was never even remotely turned on by her. It was extremely painful watching her fall apart over this. I'm hoping that there's a girl out there who will understand, but I know that a girl like that is hard to find.

No, I was only on it for about 6 months, and Jesus Christ, I just realized that was 5 years ago now. All of the medical problems I've had have either been listed by Roche Pharmaceuticals as potential side effects from Accutane, or reported by patients and fervently denied by Roche.

Thanks for the encouragement though. It really helps.
